cover_headline: Jailer 2 Dips 20 Percent on Tuesday, India Gross Reaches Rs 462.75 Crore
facts: Jailer 2 collected Rs 8.75 crore gross in India on its second Tuesday, a 20 per cent drop from Monday, according to Pinkvilla
Sacnilk puts the India nett total at Rs 415.65 crore, with worldwide gross estimated at about Rs 744 crore
In Tamil Nadu, the film is expected to enter the Rs 200 crore club in its third weekend

end.headline: Jailer 2 Dips 20 Percent on Tuesday, India Gross Reaches Rs 462.75 Crore
end.line: Pinkvilla expects the Rajinikanth starrer to close its second week near Rs 480 crore gross in India and to cross Rs 500 crore domestically if the current trend holds.
